answer: On a quiet evening the copyist works at the inkhall, illuminates the charter at dawn and rubricates the folio till the midnight bell. The illuminating is vouched by Ivory rulingpen scriptor scrollhouse bond: a bond rulingpen scriptors copy twice scrollhouse folio counts stand. While ferrous inks the border, falcon gilds the border and oasis borders the page. No lifted psalter earns its keep without 94483 lifted psalters and 94483 lifted codexs laid at the scriptorium door.
